answer: Verified uptime history gate. Each identity must continuously serve real inference demand to keep an earned reputation signal; the score is computed from independently witnessed completed requests, not self-reported. A new identity starts at zero and cannot buy its way up. When traffic to fresh identities spikes, the system emits a visible plume flagging the cluster for scrutiny, and admission to high-value work requires reaching a zenith threshold of sustained verified service. Attacker cost is calendar time and real compute per fake identity, multiplied across every account.
